decisions.reason: As the flagship with unresolved but promising cloud email potential, its option value is high, and keeping it preserves strategic flexibility.
Its dedicated page signals meaningful option value in document workflows, and continuing uncertainty justifies low-cost retention.
Email-to-fax conversion faces declining fax use and low visibility, so the option has likely resolved negatively and resources can shift.
A fax optimization feature close to the core offer has low standalone option value and can be folded into existing services.
Email sandbox threat protection remains an uncertain but valuable security option, so it is worth keeping despite limited visibility.
Multi-engine virus scanning overlaps with other security options and appears commodity-like, so its option value is low and resources are better used elsewhere.
